name: Cannon River (Faribault–Dundas)
gaugeName: Cannon River at Co. Hwy. 29 below Faribault, MN

gaugeContext.note: This same-river gauge is within the Faribault–Dundas reach. It provides flow context, not a calibrated travel speed or a guarantee of passage.

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric trip-time range is assigned.

sections.putIn: Cannon River Two Rivers Park Access
sections.takeOut: Cannon River Dundas City Park Access
sections.difficulty: Moderate current; shallow riffles in low water
sections.notes: A DNR-recommended longer paddle. Arrange a vehicle shuttle and identify the Dundas exit in advance.

notices.title: Launch below the dam
notices.text: Two Rivers Park is downstream of Woolen Mill Dam. Use the signed park launch; do not substitute an upstream access.

putIn.name: Cannon River Two Rivers Park Access

takeOut.name: Cannon River Dundas City Park Access

distanceEvidence.note: 58.4 minus 45.2 gives approximately 13.2 river miles. Carries and shuttle travel are separate. The published trip is 13.2 miles; the Two Rivers inventory mile 58.5 is not substituted.

putInAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency GPS coordinate retained at the wooded bank beside the park. Exact landing under canopy unresolved. Map mile 58.4 differs from inventory 58.5.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed city carry-in below the Straight River confluence, downstream of the Woolen Mill Dam. Identify the shoreline approach during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency GPS coordinate retained beside the park shelter and wooded shoreline. It identifies the access area without resolving an exact water-edge landing.
takeOutAccess.directions: Reach the city park from First Street, south of County Road 1. Locate the carry-in on the east bank before launching; this is upstream of the separate Mill Park access.

putInAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Cannon River map and access inventory

putInAccess.directions: Use the signed city carry-in below the Straight River confluence, downstream of the Woolen Mill Dam. Identify the shoreline approach during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Rice County — Cannon River Wilderness Area
takeOutAccess.note: Agency GPS coordinate lies in the river beside the park. Satellite clouds resolved using separate USGS NAIP imagery, but the exact landing remains unresolved. Guide mile 50.6 differs from inventory 50.8. The county says no running water, despite older DNR facility text.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the south park entrance at 3471 151st Street East and follow signs for the canoe launch. The north entrance is a different approach. Locate the exit before launching.
